item.title: Token Tuesday: as-Sharak
item.dc:creator: Kyle Norton
item.description: as-Sharak — token art by Emily Smirle, from the original blog archive.
item.content:encoded:
Today on Token Tuesday (from my backlog), Emily Smirle has served up for you the accursed as-Sharak. You'll find a portrait and both based and unbased versions of these new fantastic tokens.
